params.feedId: Adapter-specific feed identifier (Chainlink proxy address encoded in bytes32 for ChainlinkAdapter).
params.maxAgeSeconds: Maximum allowed age of oracle publish time.
params.nowTs: ABI-compat; production adapters MUST ignore it for freshness (see interface `@dev`).

returns.confidenceE8: Optional confidence band scaled to e8 (0 if unsupported).
returns.publishTime: Oracle update timestamp used for freshness/monotonicity.

getNormalizedPrice(bytes32,uint64,uint64.notice: Get latest normalized price for a feed with freshness guarantees.
